content.title: IRTC Q2 Deep Dive: Core Business Momentum and Product Expansion Shape Outlook

The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $725 million at the midpoint came in 4.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.32 per share was 32.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
